judgments.reason: The span 'short stature (1.66 m)' appears literally in the vignette and short stature is a recognized feature of Albright hereditary osteodystrophy, which characterizes PHP type 1A, clinically supporting this subtype.

The span 'Serum calcium: 1.13 mmol/L (normal range 2.2–2.6 mmol/L)' appears literally in the vignette; hypocalcemia is a hallmark biochemical finding of pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A, supporting this subtype designation.

The span 'PTH: 110 ng/L (normal range 11–67 ng/L)' appears literally in the vignette; elevated PTH in the setting of hypocalcemia indicates PTH resistance, which is the defining biochemical feature of pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A.
